title: Tecno unveils the Camon Slim 5G with a bunch of unique rear finishes
description: Today Tecno has taken the wraps off the Camon Slim 5G, a phone that does justice to its name by being 6.39mm thin. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 128/256GB of storage. The phone sports a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 1208x2644 resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera using Sony's Lytia 700C 1/1.56" type sensor with OIS, an 8MP ultrawide, a 32MP selfie camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging. title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max is official with a 13.3-inch screen, Xring O3 SoC, and a 12,000 mAh battery
description: Alongside the 18 Fold, Xiaomi today also announced the Pad 9 Pro Max, which is the company's new flagship tablet. The device features a 13.3-inch LCD screen with 3408x2272 resolution, a 3:2 aspect ratio, a 144Hz refresh rate, and a 1,000-nit peak brightness. It's powered by Xiaomi's self-developed Xring O3 chip, just like the Xiaomi 18 Fold. This is paired with 8/12/16GB of RAM and 256GB/512GB/1TB of storage. On the rear there's a 50MP camera with OIS, while for selfies there's a 32MP front camera. The tablet has a 12,000 mAh battery with support for 120W wired charging, 27W...

title: Huawei reveals the Pura X View's full specs, pricing, and launch date
description: Last month, Huawei semi-announced the Pura X View, revealing some but not all of its specs. Today, the company has finally rectified that, by fully unveiling the device with its unique form factor. The Pura X View comes with a 6.39-inch OLED screen with 1320x2232 resolution, 16:9.5 aspect ratio, 120Hz refresh rate, and 6,500-nit peak brightness at 1% APL. The display has Kunlun Glass on top and supports 2,160Hz PWM dimming. It has 1.05mm symmetrical bezels on all four sides. On the rear there's a 200MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture and OIS, an 8MP ultrawide camera with f/2.2...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold is here with the Xring O3 SoC, a wide format, and a cherry red colorway
description: Xiaomi today announced its own very first wide-style foldable smartphone, one-upping Apple by exactly two days. Not only does the Xiaomi 18 Fold have the same form factor as the much-anticipated iPhone Ultra, but it's also available in a cherry red colorway, similar to what was rumored for Apple's device. That's where the similarities end, though. The Xiaomi 18 Fold is powered by Xiaomi's impressive self-developed Xring O3 SoC, paired with 12/16GB of RAM and 256GB/512GB/1TB of storage. description: After launching the Z11x in India in March, now iQOO has quietly unveiled the Z11xa. Its listing is up on the company's website for India, and if you want to have some fun, you can try and find out what's different from the Z11x. [#InlinePriceWidget,14531,1#] Let us spare you the trouble: nothing. The specs are identical, down to the color variants. However, while the Z11x is available with both 6GB and 8GB of RAM and 128GB and 256GB of storage, the Z11xa can only be purchased with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. title: Poco C95 Pro specs and renders leak
description: Back in early September of last year, Poco launched the C85 4G. Now, the brand is apparently gearing up to release a successor of sorts. It's called Poco C95 Pro 4G and today a new leak brings us purported renders of the device as well as its most important specs. So let's dive in. The Poco C95 Pro 4G is allegedly powered by the MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset. It will reportedly have a 6.9-inch 720x1600 LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50MP rear camera, an 8MP front camera, and a 7,500 mAh battery with support for 45W fast wired charging. title: vivo X500 gets certified, its charging support is revealed
description: vivo is going to launch the X500 series this month, and ahead of that the vanilla X500 has been spotted in a bunch of certification databases. It was certified by IMDA in Singapore, SIRIM in Malaysia, as well as TÜV, with the model number V2619. The SIRIM certification confirms that this model number belongs to the X500. IMDA has confirmed that the phone has 5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and NFC, while the TÜV certification reveals that it will support 90W wired charging. According to past rumors and leaks, the vivo X500 has an OLED screen with "1.5K" resolution, and a 7,500 mAh battery...

title: Samsung Galaxy A07s debuts with a 6.7-inch screen, 5,000mAh battery
description: Back in August, the Samsung Galaxy A07s appeared on the Google Play Console alongside the Galaxy A08. Now, the budget smartphone seems to have been quietly launched in the Levant region and is already available to purchase. The Galaxy A07s comes equipped with an octa-core 6nm MediaTek G99+ chipset, which is paired with up to 6GB of RAM and up to 128GB of storage. A microSD card slot is available for storage expansion. description: Oppo has finally confirmed that its Find X10 flagship series will launch in China this month. The company has also revealed some details about the upcoming phones and offered a glimpse at their design. title: Poco X8 unboxing
description: The Poco X8 made its global debut alongside the more premium F9 Pro and F9 Ultra, and what it lacks in premiumness, it makes up for in battery. Let's begin. The Poco X8 is already on sale. It costs €400 for the 8/256GB model, and €450 if you want 12GB of RAM instead of 8. There are three colors: black, white, and orange. In the box, you'll find a USB cable, as well as a case. The case is your typical grey rubber affair, but it does its job. You'll need to supply your own charger for the Poco X8. title: iQOO 16 now tipped to pack an 8,400 mAh battery
description: Reliable tipster Digital Chat Station had earlier claimed that the iQOO 16, expected to launch this month, would pack an 8,500 mAh battery. Now, the tipster says the smartphone is confirmed to come with an 8,400 mAh battery. Even if the iQOO 16's battery capacity is lower than previously rumored, it is still higher than the iQOO 15's 7,000 mAh battery capacity. description: The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max could get a completely refreshed color palette this year. description: The fans have spoken – the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE isn’t it. It could be, but the results from last week’s poll make it very clear that the S26 FE train isn’t leaving the station without a tangible price drop. As things stand right now, people are gravitating towards other Galaxy models – the Galaxy S25 FE and S26+ in particular offer similar specs at better value-for-money – or they are exploring alternatives outside of Samsung. description: Huawei's got a watch for everyone - whether you're into smart bands (the Fit and Band series), affordable classic watches (the GT line), all-out superwatches (the Ultimate), and if you're into classy timepieces that aren't your regular watch lookalike, there's the Watch series. Unfortunately, like with most of the industry, the days of outright silly products like the iPod Socks (yes, we are not making this up) seem to be gone now. But that doesn’t mean there isn’t still room for somewhat stranger products. Apparently, Cupertino is working on two different game controllers, or at least that’s what code found inside macOS 26.7 suggests.
